summary: Show Recycled Action Plan Template Section
description: Returns a Recycled Action Plan Template Section

id.description: Unique identifier of the deleted template section.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the section was created. ISO 8601 format.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp when the section was moved to the recycle bin. ISO 8601 format.

plan_template_id.description: Unique identifier of the parent Action Plan Template.

position.description: Ordinal position of this section within the template. Use to determine display order.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the section was last modified. ISO 8601 format.
